caveats: Copernicus is a surface model and can include vegetation and infrastructure.
LOLA Site01 is an interpolated product; uncertainty clones have not been propagated.
Slopes use native-pixel area averaging to a 100 m grid with 200 m central-difference support.
POWER air temperature is not MODIS land-surface temperature. Meteorology is shown as context, not a lunar temperature or illumination score.
The demonstration mission rankings remain separate and still use placeholder measurements.
